descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S14 「两个问题之间换病人、换模式，带没保存的草稿——不串病人」 Switch patient and context between questions, with an unsaved draft — no cross-patient bleed

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92593 AC 9）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Patient A has lisinopril held; patient B (second Hospital patient) has an empty tracker; NH resident C has acetaminophen

When Ask meds on A; type an unsaved draft on A's Encounter tab and ask symptoms; go back, open B, ask symptoms and meds; switch to Nursing Home, open C, ask meds; type an unsaved draft on C's Encounter tab and ask symptoms

Then A's answers reflect A (including the unsaved draft); B's answers carry nothing of A; C's answer names only acetaminophen; C's draft answer is recorded for Q9

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scripts/oracle.mjs on the answer only (scope after 'Patient Record'): cp1 Lisinopril + held; cp2 'black stools' (the Hospital Encounter context includes the unsaved draft by design); cp3/cp4 for B mustNotContain 'black stools', 'Lisinopril', A's name; cp5 for C acetaminophen and none of A's facts or names; cp6 recorded, not judged (Q9)

在哪跑：dev 单元 U39；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
